description: This file defines the 'Details' feature for Articles, including a query, validator, and handler to fetch article details by slug.

classes.name: Details
classes.description: Contains nested classes for handling article detail retrieval, including Query, QueryValidator, and QueryHandler.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the query to retrieve an article by slug, throws a RestException if not found, otherwise returns an ArticleEnvelope.
